experiences.title: AI/ML Engineer
experiences.description: Building production RAG, Dataiku workflows, and automation on internal reporting data — owning architecture, evaluation, and the workflows that put analytics in non-technical hands.
responsibilities: Built a production RAG assistant using OpenAI APIs, LangChain, and Pinecone, enabling non-technical stakeholders to query analytics in natural language and reducing ad-hoc reporting requests.
Designed chunking strategy, embedding selection, and prompt templates with guardrails and structured evaluation metrics such as faithfulness, answer relevance, and retrieval precision.

Built and operationalized data preparation and machine learning workflows in Dataiku DSS, using visual recipes, reusable datasets, and governed project flows to streamline collaboration between technical and business teams.
Owned data architecture for 3 production databases across 5+ concurrent projects, including schema design, indexing, and integrity constraints that reduced downstream engineering corrections by 15%.
Designed 10+ Python and SQL automation workflows replacing manual reporting, recovering 20 analyst-hours per month and improving data freshness to near real time.
Profiled production logs to isolate bottlenecks and shipped targeted fixes, delivering a 10% performance gain and 25% fewer critical errors with full regression coverage.

experiences.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern
experiences.description: Built ML services and pipelines from scratch — anomaly detection, GCP model pipelines, and ETL redesign across a subscriber base of millions.
responsibilities: Built a Python anomaly detection service from scratch using Isolation Forest with threshold-based fallbacks, improving hardware fault detection accuracy by 25% and network reliability by 20%.
Developed and evaluated ML pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Vertex AI), driving team-wide migration off legacy analytics tooling through enablement sessions across 3+ teams.
Redesigned 8 ETL pipelines in Palantir Foundry as automated, idempotent workflows, achieving 30% faster processing and establishing new data-reliability standards across the organization.
Designed A/B testing infrastructure for ML-driven feature evaluations, bringing statistical rigor to rollout decisions previously based on intuition.

experiences.title: Programmer Analyst
experiences.description: Architected data-quality and forecasting systems at scale on AWS — profiling, validation, and demand models across millions of records.
responsibilities: Architected an end-to-end data quality system with AWS Glue and Python across 12 interdependent datasets, automating profiling, schema validation, and anomaly flagging to improve pipeline reliability.

Designed forecasting models in Python and Amazon Athena over 500,000+ records, improving demand-planning accuracy by 10% and contributing to an 8% quarterly revenue uplift by surfacing stronger signals.
Standardized cross-functional data definitions and delivery cadence across 4 teams, cutting reporting turnaround by 25%.
